title: Review loop
description: A coder implements, a reviewer reviews, until the reviewer approves.

nodes.prompt: Implement the task in this worktree with tests, and commit when they pass. Task: {{input}}
Review the latest commits of session {{node.coder}} in this worktree for bugs and missing tests. Do not edit code.

edges.text: The reviewer asks for changes: read its last reply with agents_transcript {"session":"{{node.reviewer}}"}, fix them and commit.
The coder stopped with an error ({{payload.status}}). Look at its transcript and tell it how to continue with agents_prompt.
